name: Passkey MFA Sign-In
summary: A password-proved user with a pending MFA challenge completes Passkey as the selected second factor and establishes the authenticated application session.
finalOutcome: The challenge-bound durable user proves a registered Passkey, the password-issued MFA challenge is consumed, and the authenticated application session is established.

sourceReferences.note: Dedicated Passkey MFA begin, browser-complete and mobile-token endpoints validate provider=passkey against the password-issued challenge and bind WebAuthn proof to that challenge's durable UserId.
Angular reuses auth.continue.passkey and selects the generated MFA Passkey operations whenever a password-issued MFA challenge is active.
React Native reuses auth.continue.passkey, consumes the in-memory MFA challenge through generated MFA Passkey token completion, and restores the authenticated token-backed session.
Generated contracts expose the three Passkey MFA operations used by the stable clients.
The existing canonical Passkey continuation view is shared between primary email-bound Passkey authentication and password-bound Passkey MFA.
Passkey and TOTP are interchangeable allowed second-factor completions when both are present on the same password-issued MFA challenge.
